dual_query_rule.name: original_plus_at_most_one_alternative_phrasing
dual_query_rule.description: Search the original question. If a general rule produces one alternative phrasing (quoted span already in the question, or a light speech/wording rewrite), search that too, merge/dedupe via RRF, and still send 20 to Qwen. Qwen scores against the original question.
